finding: Only a claim and --plan-seed recognise the marker commit (BR-097). The read of the move has no outcome for a marker or a missing counter, although both occur: two sessions in two worktrees both offer the move at the session start (BR-106 checks only the setting and origin), so the second move reads the first one's marker; and a User who declines the seed keeps the setting without a counter (CIF-G06). init-factory also counts a marker as a seeded counter (BR-105), so fitting.counter_seeded is true while every claim fails. Define the outcome of a move that reads a marker or no counter, and state whether the fitting key treats a marker as seeded.
why_this_severity: The affected scenario, QS-23, has priority 2, so importance is medium; every ordering checked fails loudly and hands out no ID twice, and only the message and the fitting key may mislead, so exposure is uncertain.
